subject: Locked Cars I never got!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have never completed Burnout! 😳

On Burnout 3 I drove the Super Assassin and never unlocked the Euro Racer. On Revenge on the original Xbox I raced with the Works 202 and never unlocked the Revenge Racer.

Now, I race the Revenge Racer but it's not unlocked for offline play!

To my shame, I have not unlocked all the cars by myself on any of the Burnout games.

I will try to in Paradise tho!!

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Joy!
author: Jasman
body:
Oh yes, I truly enjoyed my first session of Revenge on the 360, and this site has learned me a thing or too that I didn't already know from my earlier Burnout experiences.

I totally agree that a featured-article series on the different tracks of Burnouts 1-4 would be awesome! I hope Xan or somebody else can come up with the source material for such an article.

Regards Jasman / Yean Budobu - Crashing in a room near you

subject: Was it me?
author: SUFFUR
body:
I know in the first couple of races i tried, but since everyone else was trying too, i got caught up in it all and got taken down by everyone, to almost the point that i was owned by most in the room. So i just got on with racing, not that i won a single race, i think i came second once, in the whole session. So getting that cherry is a surprise and means i got more out of the day, than i could get out of Zom and Xan, plus it nice to play again. But i have to admit i am not playing so well, i think i'm trying to unlearn what i have done in the past so i don't, have any pre-concived ideas about driving in Paradise. All the Burnout games, had different ways of driving (we used different cars, d'oh), and Revenge has lulled me, as the Revenge Racer is now the standard car of choice. For future hosts, if i jump in, can we have the rooms unrestricted, i miss my 205s and other cars of lesser speed, you can keep the Revenge, i may not win (probably time out too), but at least, i'm driving and having some fun, and i have been know to beat, the Revenge Racer, though more so on the XBox version, as i was the last in the group to get it, I think even Zom got hers before me, but still raced the Works, which was a 205, now a 202, from time to time.

So Yean, did you enjoy your first game on the 360, and has this site helped you, learn how to boost jump and other glitches, and be a better racer?

Oh, and does anyone have any overhead pictures of the tracks, from all the games of Burnout, it would be a good feature and FAQ, for new and old racers? If anyone from Criterion reads this, please contact Xandu, you know his real name and where he lives, and can supply said pictures, that would be great. It would be nice, as an article about tracks of Burnout,and would give closure, since they are not part of the way the game will be played, from when Paradise is released.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
